title: Jacoby Brissett reportedly not attending start of Cardinals' offseason program, asking for starter-caliber extension

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jacoby Brissett reportedly not attending start of Cardinals' offseason program, asking for starter-caliber extension
sources.description: Arizona's only QBs right now are Brissett, Gardner Minshew II and Kedon Slovis, but the team is speculated to be in the running to draft Ty Simpson.
